# Home Environment Manager v0.5.1 — Home Assistant Python 3.14 compatibility

## Fix for failed integration setup

- Replace the mandatory `pythermalcomfort==4.6.2` dependency with a
  built-in, numerical-equivalent scalar ISO 7730 Fanger PMV/PPD routine.
- Avoid the transitive NumPy/SciPy/Numba/`llvmlite` installation chain that
  fails to provide a compatible `llvmlite` binary wheel for the Alpine/musl
  Python 3.14 Home Assistant runtime and may attempt an unavailable LLVM/CMake
  source build.
- Keep PMV/PPD environmental diagnostics and their complete input-validity
  restrictions rather than disabling advanced comfort when the package fails.
- Reference-check output against published `pythermalcomfort` 4.6.2 vectors,
  including its 2005/2025 Fanger numeric equations. Include its MIT attribution.
- Add a regression gate asserting no heavy third-party package requirements.

## Compatibility

The `air_quality_advisor` domain, entity IDs, configuration, Lovelace card,
room notifications, Announcement Hub routing, sensor history and v0.5.0 PID
actuator policies are unchanged. No reconfiguration or manually installed
Python packages are required after updating to v0.5.1.

The release is published only after Python/JavaScript tests, translations,
Home Assistant Hassfest and HACS validations all pass. All real actuator
safety safeguards and explicit opt-ins remain mandatory.
